input: Plan a neighborhood skill-sharing swap event

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Neighborhood Skill-Sharing Swap Event
gold.taskDescription: Organize a community event where neighbors exchange skills, knowledge, or services with one another.

questions.title: What skills or categories should the swap focus on?
questions.description: Understand whether the event is open to any skills (cooking, gardening, tech, crafts, etc.) or narrowed to specific themes.

questions.title: How many neighbors do you expect to participate?
questions.description: Gauge the expected headcount to plan logistics such as space, materials, and scheduling.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: Determine when the event should take place to build a realistic planning timeline.

questions.title: Where will the event be physically held?
questions.description: Identify the venue — such as a park, community center, someone's backyard, or a rented space.

questions.title: Is this a one-time event or a recurring series?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a standalone swap or the first of many, which affects how formal the structure needs to be.

questions.title: What is the budget available for organizing this event?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to plan for permits, supplies, promotion, food, and any other costs.

questions.title: How will participants sign up or register their skills?
questions.description: Determine the preferred method for collecting skill offerings — such as a form, app, flyer, or word of mouth.
